mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BASIL_SEC_PRD.USERS (NAME, COMPANY_ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD, PASS_TOKEN, PASS_TOKEN_EXP, STATUS, CREATOR, MODIFIER, STANDARD_USER) VALUES(#{name}, #{companyId}, #{email}, #{password}, #{token}, #{tokenExp}, #{status}, #{creator}, #{creator}, #{standardUser});
mapper.select: SELECT STATUS FROM BASIL_SEC_PRD.USERS where U_OID=#{id};

SELECT U_OID as id, NAME, COMPANY_ID, EMAIL, STATUS, (CASE WHEN STATUS = 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN STATUS = 2 THEN 'Disabled' WHEN STATUS = 3 THEN 'Inactive' END) statusStr, CREATED, PASSWORD, LAST_LOGIN_DATE as lastLoginDate, STANDARD_USER FROM BASIL_SEC_PRD.USERS WHERE EMAIL=#{email};

SELECT U_OID as id, NAME, COMPANY_ID, EMAIL, STATUS, (CASE WHEN STATUS = 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN STATUS = 2 THEN 'Disabled' WHEN STATUS = 3 THEN 'Inactive' END) statusStr, CREATED, PASSWORD, LAST_LOGIN_DATE as lastLoginDate FROM BASIL_SEC_PRD.USERS WHERE PASS_TOKEN=#{token};

SELECT U_OID as id, NAME, COMPANY_ID, EMAIL, STATUS, (CASE WHEN STATUS = 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN STATUS = 2 THEN 'Disabled' WHEN STATUS = 3 THEN 'Inactive' END) statusStr, CREATED, PASSWORD, LAST_LOGIN_DATE as lastLoginDate, STANDARD_USER FROM BASIL_SEC_PRD.USERS WHERE U_OID=#{id};

SELECT MC_OID as id, CUSTOMER_ORGANIZATION as organization, CLIENT_GROUP AS clientGroupId, sav.VALUE AS clientGroup FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_CUSTOMER co LEFT JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES sav ON sav.SAV_OID = co.CLIENT_GROUP WHERE CUSTOMER_ORGANIZATION LIKE concat('%',#{name},'%')

SELECT MC_OID as id, CUSTOMER_ORGANIZATION as organization, CLIENT_GROUP AS clientGroupId, sav.VALUE AS clientGroup FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_CUSTOMER co LEFT JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES sav ON sav.SAV_OID = co.CLIENT_GROUP WHERE MC_OID = #{id}
SELECT CUSTOMER_ORGANIZATION FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_CUSTOMER WHERE MC_OID=#{id};
mapper.update:
